title: lever-consumer closure for the stable 534brn digit-index sequence

historical_bruteforce.method: De Bruijn-style exhaustive coverage of all 3-symbol lever words through length 14
historical_bruteforce.community_result: all segments completed; no unknown code result

consequence: RRURRURUR, as a 9-command lever word, is necessarily included in that completed search and produced no new bunker-door result.
caveats: This closes the ordinary lever-door consumer in the tested game state, not every imaginable stateful or context-dependent lever use.
Historical testers reported the known bunker code still worked after long runs of failed inputs, arguing against a simple anti-bruteforce lockout.
epistemic_effect: Experiment 398 remains a robust derived nine-symbol feature, but its obvious lever interpretation is historically falsified as a new bunker-door code.
